answer: A practical defence is Midwife licence with health department attestation. It rests on a midwife licence number verifiable in the health department register, which gives every honest agent a saffron that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the cipher compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The comet is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
